gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sausblubje: Rarity: Common (bounces around the Guhbarbecuether, mostly in the Smoke Delta)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sausblubje: A bouncing blubby of sauce with a little crust. Give it a cuddle or a cheese nibble and it splits in two smaller blubbies out of pure joy, leaving blub cream behind. A small blubby grows a size again after three nibbles, and fits exactly in a glass bottle.
gui.guhs.guhdex.rarity.sausloper: Rarity: Uncommon (the frying sauce sea of the Guhbarbecuether)
gui.guhs.guhdex.info.sausloper: A sweet guh on very long legs, with a quiff of fries. He strolls across the cheese frying sauce as if it were a sidewalk, but on dry land he shivers with cold. After the Caretaker Guh's lesson at the Sauce Strider Stable you can tame one yourself with peanut sprouts. Saddle on, Peanut Sauce on a Stick in your hand, and he walks wherever you look.
gui.guhs.kledingbron.toren_peper: The Lighthouse Keeper Guh and the Pepper Grower Guh (Guhbarbecuether)
structure.guhs.sausloper_stal.tooltip: The stable of the Sauce Striders, with the Caretaker Guh and a test ride through the sauce basin (Guhbarbecuether)
item.guhs.blubroom.lore: A warm dollop from a happy Sauce Blubby. For the Guh Brewing Cauldron, and for saucy inventions
item.guhs.sausblubje_potje.lore: It blubs happily against the glass. Nyeg
item.guhs.sausblubje_potje.tooltip: Right-click a block to set it free again
item.guhs.sausdieren_pindasaus_stok.lore: A Sauce Strider trots after it, all wahoog. Right-click while riding for a little sprint
item.guhs.guhdrankje.blubroom.lore: Cheese broth with blub cream. You don't fall anymore, you bounce. Boing, nyeg!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.blijft: %s waits here like a good boy
gui.guhs.sausdieren.leen_ander: This Sauce Strider is waiting for somebody else. Ask the Caretaker Guh for a test ride of your own
gui.guhs.sausdieren.stok_nodig: Hold Peanut Sauce on a Stick: he walks wherever you look
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_bewoner: %s sniffs your hand. Got any peanut sprouts on you?
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_leen: %s is ready for your test ride. Hop on!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_tam: %s wags his curly little tail. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_zadel: %s is yours. Put a saddle on him and you can ride
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_wild: %s gives you a shy look. He wouldn't say no to peanut sprouts
gui.guhs.sausdieren.aai_onbekend: %s doesn't know you yet. The Caretaker Guh at the Sauce Strider Stable will teach you how it's done
gui.guhs.sausdieren.eerst_stal: %s sniffs, but doesn't dare. First learn how to make friends from the Caretaker Guh at the Sauce Strider Stable
gui.guhs.sausdieren.getemd: %s is now your very own Sauce Strider! Put a saddle on him
gui.guhs.sausdieren.niet_slaan: Nyeg! You don't bonk a Sauce Strider, you pet him
gui.guhs.sausdieren.njam: Nom! The Sauce Strider munches happily
gui.guhs.sausdieren.te_groot_voor_potje: %s doesn't fit in your bottle. Only a small blubby fits
gui.guhs.sausdieren.gegroeid: %s grew a size from all those nibbles. Blub!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.nog_voer: Blub! %s more nibble(s) and it grows a size
gui.guhs.sausdieren.knuffel_klein: %s blubs with joy. It doesn't get any smaller than this
gui.guhs.sausdieren.gesplitst: Blub blub! %s splits with joy and leaves blub cream behind
gui.guhs.sausdieren.niet_slaan_blubje: Nyeg! You don't bonk a Sauce Blubby, you cuddle it
gui.guhs.sausdieren.poortje: Gate %s of %s: follow the little stars
gui.guhs.sausdieren.stap_op: Hop on your Sauce Strider (right-click) for gate %s of %s
gui.guhs.sausdieren.te_ver: Whoa whoa, he can't go that far from the stable. Back to the start!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.rondje_klaar: Your test lap is done in %s seconds. Wahoog!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.rondje_record: A lap in %s seconds: your fastest so far. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.sausdieren.optie.uitleg: How do I tame one myself?
gui.guhs.sausdieren.optie.blubje: Do you have a Sauce Blubby for me?
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.hallo: Nyeg! Welcome to the Sauce Strider Stable. My striders step through the frying sauce all day long, because on dry land they get cold little feet. Want to learn how to make friends with them? Then later you can tame one yourself.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.lok: Here, Peanut Sauce on a Stick. They trot after it, all wahoog. Go on, lure one out of the sauce basin over to me!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.stok_kwi: Lost your stick? Licked it clean, I bet. Here's a new one, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.gelokt: Look at him step! And see him shiver? That's the cold. Come on, let's warm him up from the inside.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer: Friendship goes through the tummy. Here are three peanut sprouts: feed them to a Sauce Strider from the stable.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer_nog: %s more peanut sprout(s) and he trusts you. Feed them to a Sauce Strider here in the stable, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.voer_kwi: Out of sprouts? Gobbled them up yourself, I bet, nyeg. Here are %s more. But these really are for the Sauce Strider!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.proefrit: He trusts you! Time for a test lap through the sauce basin: through the four gates, ending at the checkered finish. Hold on tight to your stick, he walks wherever you look.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.start: Fweet-fwee! There's your Sauce Strider, by the dock. Hop on and follow the little stars. No rush, he can't tip over.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.start_op: Fweet-fwee! There he is again. I'll time your lap, nyeg.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.klaar: What a ride! You're a real Sauce Strider Friend now. Here's a saddle, and some peanut sprouts for the road. The wild striders on the sauce sea will dare to come up to you now, too.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.na: Nyeg, there's my best student! Fancy a lap through the sauce basin? I'll time you.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.uitleg: Find a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea and feed him peanut sprouts until he gives hearts. Saddle on, stick in your hand and off you ride. Sneak and click to make him wait. And don't leave him standing on dry land too long!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje: A blubby? They bounce between my little legs all day long here. Here, one in a jar. Set it free at home, give it three cheese nibbles and it grows. Then one cuddle and you have two, with a dollop of blub cream on the side. Nyeg!
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje_h: You've still got one sitting in a jar, nyeg. Set that one free first.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.verzorger.blubje_m: You already got one from me today. Tomorrow a new blubby is sure to bounce into the stable.
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.lok: lure a Sauce Strider to the Caretaker Guh with the Peanut Sauce on a Stick
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.gelokt: ask the Caretaker Guh what a Sauce Strider likes to eat
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.voer: feed a Sauce Strider from the stable three peanut sprouts
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.nog_voer: one more peanut sprout for the Sauce Strider
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.vertrouwt: ask the Caretaker Guh for your test ride
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.proefrit: hop on at the dock, hold the stick and ride through the four gates
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.terug: pick up your saddle from the Caretaker Guh
quest.guhs.sausdieren.hint.klaar: tame a wild Sauce Strider on the frying sauce sea with peanut sprouts

item.guhs.torenpeper_peperzaadjes.lore: One little plant, three peppers: the soil decides which
Peanut Sauce Nylium: pink Candy Pepper
item.guhs.torenpeper_peperzaadjes.glas: Under glass it grows three times as fast
item.guhs.torenpeper_njegpeper.lore: Green and mild. Well, mild... nyeg
item.guhs.torenpeper_vahoegpeper.lore: Red and hot! Eat it raw at your own risk. For the Pepperfire Potion
item.guhs.torenpeper_snoeppeper.lore: Pink and sweet as a cuddle. For the Peppersweet Potion
item.guhs.guhdrankje.pepervuur.lore: Cheese broth with Wahoog Pepper. You chop and dig like wildfire, with little flames coming out of your snoot. Nyeg!
item.guhs.guhdrankje.peperzoet.lore: Cheese broth with Candy Pepper. Warm and sweet inside: two extra hearts
item.guhs.torenpeper_seinlantaarn.lore: Lost Smoke Guhs follow whoever holds it. Red and white, just like the tower
item.guhs.torenpeper_lampkooltje.lore: Pressed glowcoal dust for the Lighthouse Lamp. Still warm
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.uit: The lamp is out. Ask the Lighthouse Keeper Guh what he needs
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.geen_kooltje: You need a Lamp Ember. The Lighthouse Keeper Guh is sure to have another one
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.aan: Fwoop! The lamp is lit. TOOOOT, there goes the foghorn
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.brandt_zoek: The lamp is lit. Smoke Guhs home: %s of %s
gui.guhs.torenpeper.lamp.brandt: The lamp stays lit as long as you're nearby. Nyeg!
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.thuis: WAHOOG! Smoke Guh %s of %s is home
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.van_ander: %s is looking for somebody else's light
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.volgt: %s follows your Signal Lantern. Just walk to the lighthouse
gui.guhs.torenpeper.rookguh.pak_lantaarn: %s can't see you in the smoke. Hold the Signal Lantern
gui.guhs.torenpeper.heet: HOT! HOT! HOOOOT! Nyeg nyeg nyeg!
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.eerst_praten: This is one of the Pepper Grower Guh's Grow Boxes. Ask him for Pepper Seeds first
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.leeg: An empty Grow Box. Plant a pepper seed in it (hold it in your hand)
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.geplant: Planted! Under glass it's ripe in %s seconds
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.groeit: Your little plant is growing. %s more seconds
gui.guhs.torenpeper.kweek.geplukt: Picked: %s! You get your seed back
gui.guhs.torenpeper.optie.rookguhs: How are the Smoke Guhs doing?
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.hallo: Ahoy, nyeg! I'm the Lighthouse Keeper Guh. See that lamp up there? Out. For weeks. And without light the Smoke Guhs can't find their way home through all that smoke. They just wander around, thin with hunger. Will you help me get the lamp lit again?
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.gruis: Wahoog! The lamp burns on glowcoal. Bring me %s Glowcoal Dust and I'll press it into a Lamp Ember. Glowcoal hangs glowing from the ceiling all over the place here.
You have %s Glowcoal Dust, I need %s for one Lamp Ember. Smash a chunk of glowcoal to bits, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.koolt: Look at that, a Lamp Ember! Still warm. Climb into the tower, all the way to the top, and put it in the lamp. And take my Signal Lantern with you: you'll need it later.
Lost your Lamp Ember? Those things do roll off everywhere. Here, I still had one in my sou'wester.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.lamp: The stairs are inside, round and round and round. At the top you put the Lamp Ember in the lamp. I'll stay here, my little legs are too short for all those steps.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.lanta: Lost your Signal Lantern? Without a lantern no Smoke Guh will follow you. Here's my spare, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.zoek: It's lit! But the lost Smoke Guhs don't dare come alone. %s are still roaming around the tower. Walk up to them with the Signal Lantern in your paw, and they'll float along behind you until they see the light.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.klaar: All three home, and they've eaten the whole Nibble Trough empty. WAHOOG! Here: a Delivery Guhling Whistle. Those little scooter guhlings listen to it. And this Lighthouse Keeper's Coat is for your guh, so he's a bit of a lighthouse keeper too.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.na: Ahoy, Lamplighter! As long as you're nearby, the lamp stays lit. The Smoke Guhs wave every evening. Well, it's always evening here.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.rookg: Chubby and pink, just as they should be! If you meet another skinny one out in the smoke, give him six cheese nibbles and he'll float straight home.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.torenwachter.fluit: Your whistle is right there in your pocket, nyeg. Have a look.
I already gave you a new whistle today. Tomorrow I'll have carved another one.
Blew away? Whistles do that. Here's a new one, take good care of it!
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.gruis: bring the Lighthouse Keeper Guh four Glowcoal Dust
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.lamp: climb into the lighthouse and put the Lamp Ember in the lamp
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.rookguhs: find the three Lost Smoke Guhs around the tower and bring them to the light with the Signal Lantern
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.allemaal_thui: all the Smoke Guhs are home: go back to the Lighthouse Keeper Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.klaar_toren: put down a Scooter Station and whistle for your Delivery Guhling
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.hallo: Nyeg! Welcome to the Pepper Garden. This is where I grow the only plant that actually likes all that smoke: the pepper. One little plant, three peppers. Which one you get depends on the soil. Want to try it yourself? I have three Grow Boxes waiting for you in the greenhouse.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.kweek: Here are three Pepper Seeds. In the greenhouse there are three Grow Boxes: Ash Dirt, Glowcoal and Peanut Sauce Nylium. Plant a seed in each box. Under glass they're ripe in no time, and your plants really are yours: nobody picks them from under your snoot.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.kweek_n: %s more kind(s) to pick. Ripe peppers hang there bright red, green or pink. Just click the box, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.zaadjes: Out of seeds? Ate them, I bet. They don't even taste good! Here, new ones. These go in the Grow Box.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw: Three kinds, right the first time! Now for the real work: pepper potion. Here's a pinch of Grill Skewer Powder, a Bucket of Cheese Sauce and three bottles. My Guh Brewing Cauldron is at the back of the greenhouse. Fire it up, pour in the sauce, stir in a Wahoog Pepper or a Candy Pepper and tap a bottle. Green Nyeg Peppers are for nibbling, not for brewing.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw_n: The cauldron is at the back of the greenhouse. Powder in, cheese sauce in, stir in a red or pink pepper, let it bubble a bit and then fill a bottle. I want a taste, nyeg!
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.brouw_w: Out of powder and no sauce left? Well, my cauldron belongs to everyone: whoever stirs first, brews. Here, a fresh pinch of Grill Skewer Powder and a new Bucket of Cheese Sauce. As soon as YOUR pepper goes in, it counts for you, nyeg.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.peper_o: No red or pink pepper left? Here's a seed. Plant it in the box with Glowcoal or Peanut Sauce Nylium: your Grow Boxes stay yours.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.klaar: Let me have a sniff... Ooh. OOH. That's a good one! You're a real Pepper Brewer. Here: a bag of seeds for home, a bottle of the other potion and a Pepper Garland for your guh. On Ash Dirt they grow anywhere, but under glass it goes three times as fast.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.na: There's my best student! Your Grow Boxes are always ready for you. And feel free to pick a pepper from the display beds, that's what they're there for.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.uitleg: Ash Dirt: the green Nyeg Pepper, nice and mild. Glowcoal: the red Wahoog Pepper, hot! That one goes in the Pepperfire Potion. Peanut Sauce Nylium: the pink Candy Pepper, sweet. That one goes in the Peppersweet Potion. Put glass above them and they grow three times as fast. Ripe? Right-click to pick, and the plant just keeps on growing.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.peperteler.zaadjes: You still have seeds in your pocket, nyeg. Those will do just fine.
You already got seeds from me today. Tomorrow I'll have dried some new ones.
All out of seeds? Here are two. Tip: if you dig up a ripe plant instead of picking it, you get extra seeds.
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.kweek: plant a pepper seed in each of the three Grow Boxes in the greenhouse and pick the ripe peppers
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.nog_plukken: another pepper picked: now the other Grow Boxes
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.geplukt: you've grown all three peppers: go back to the Pepper Grower Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.brouw: brew a pepper potion in the Guh Brewing Cauldron at the back of the greenhouse
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.gebrouwen: your first pepper potion! Let the Pepper Grower Guh have a taste
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.borrelt: your pepper is bubbling in the cauldron: fill a bottle in a moment and go back to the Pepper Grower Guh
quest.guhs.torenpeper.hint.klaar_tuin: plant your Pepper Seeds at home on Ash Dirt, Glowcoal or Peanut Sauce Nylium, preferably under glass
advancements.guhs.barbecuether.toren_pep: Light the lamp of the Smoke Guh Lighthouse and bring three Lost Smoke Guhs home
Grow the three peppers in the greenhouse of the Pepper Garden and brew your first pepper potion
Eat a raw Wahoog Pepper. Nobody said it was smart
